name: MltLanguageBlock
meaning: mapping from the configuration language index (byte at *(void**)0x57b80c + 0xBB) to the MLT block index that Load_MLT's string-bank builder 0x548980 skips to, performed by 0x548D76. Values outside 0..3 pass through unchanged

name: MLT_CFG3_BLOCK6
meaning: config language 3 reads MLT block 6 - the only non-consecutive entry, and the one that can walk past the end of the buffer
